what_would_settle_it: detail: the customer record's fields (tags, notes, metrics), how a guest's order relates to a customer record (WooCommerce's guest checkout setting is in CM-CUS-010), and when and how duplicate records are merged (only Shopify's merge is held)

detail: which pages the buyer's account holds (orders, returns, addresses, profile, subscriptions, wishlist) and which sign-in methods each platform offers (password, one-time code, WhatsApp code, social or outside identity provider)

detail: which settings may key on a customer group and how (prices through price lists: BC-S-0048, BC-S-0050; promotions and product access: BC-S-0209; payment methods restricted by customer or company: CM-PAY-019); no held statement names a shipping rate or restriction keyed on a customer group, only shipping restrictions in CM-SHP-001 (ZD-S-0855, SA-S-2112)

detail: the list of storefront events each platform reports (Shopify's standard events such as checkout_started and cart_viewed are in CM-MKT-009) and the consent each event waits for (Shopify: callbacks run only after consent where consent is required, SH-S-0707; the merchant is responsible for consents, SH-S-0067)

detail: quantity rules for business buyers (minimums, maximums and increments per catalog or company); the cells hold only Shopify's add-to-cart limit (SH-S-7483, CM-CHK-002) and BigCommerce's bulk pricing rules (BC-S-0017, CM-CAT-013); Shopify's store feature volumePricingEnabled is unplaced (outscope SH-I-2603)
detail: how a catalog or price list is assigned (to a company location, a customer group, a channel or a market: BC-S-0050) and which applies when several match

detail: the discount types each platform offers (buy X get Y, free shipping, tiered; Shopify's function targets for order, product and shipping discounts are in CM-MKT-004) and how discounts combine and conflicts resolve (Salla's and Zid's multiple-coupon settings are in CM-MKT-002); no held statement names buy X get Y or tiered discounts
detail: how an order is credited to an affiliate, referral or creator, and what the attribution record holds

detail: whether conversions reach ad platforms from the server (conversion APIs) or from the browser; Salla's flags facebook-conversion, snapchat-conversion and tiktok-conversion are apps (SA-S-3216 to SA-S-3218, a reading that they carry conversions), and no held statement names a server-side conversion API
detail: how reviews and questions are moderated (approval, replies, hiding) and where they show
detail: the platform's steps as mediator once a buyer complains (CM-TRU-020), and how Salla's quality gateway passes a merchant's complaint to the carrier (SA-S-5070)

detail: each platform's reports and metrics and their granularity; who builds a custom report: the cells hold apps and developers building them (Salla's Report Creator, SA-S-5146; Shopify's ShopifyQL for apps, SH-S-5905), and no held statement shows a merchant building one in the admin (Shopify's store feature reportsEditing is unplaced, outscope SH-I-2593)

Sharrwah's own design (a reading): the references' evidence holds what their analytics show, not the architecture behind them; engineering decides event capture, aggregation and freshness, informed by CM-MKT-009, CM-ANL-001 and CM-ANL-007
detail: the list of notifications each platform sends, to whom, on which channel and on which event (WooCommerce's customer emails are listed in CM-NTF-001)

detail: what a merchant may change in each notification: template and its code (BigCommerce's Handlebars templates, BC-S-0258), language (Zid's Message Language), sender identity (CM-NTF-004) and on or off (WooCommerce's per-email setting, WC-S-5412)

the class's channels and the slot for their providers are in CM-NTF-004; each market's sender rules (SMS sender registration, WhatsApp Business) need a subject that covers messaging in each market, which subjects.tsv doesn't list, with the regulators and providers reached through the founder; which providers Sharrwah partners with is the founder's (commercial agreements and partners)
